name: Path of the World Tree

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A barbarian rooted in the cosmic tree, sharing its vitality with allies and dragging foes through its branches.

feature.name: Vitality of the Tree
feature.summary: When you rage, gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Barbarian level; each turn while raging, give an ally nearby d6s of Temporary Hit Points.
feature.text: Vitality Surge: when you enter your Rage, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Barbarian level. Life-Giving Force: at the start of each of your turns while raging, you can choose another creature within 10 feet of you; it gains Temporary Hit Points equal to a roll of d6s numbering your Rage Damage bonus. Those Temporary Hit Points vanish when your Rage ends.

feature.name: Branches of the Tree
feature.summary: Reaction while raging: a creature within 30 feet makes a Strength save or is teleported next to you and its Speed drops to 0.
feature.text: While your Rage is active, when a creature you can see starts its turn within 30 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to summon spectral branches around it. It makes a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your Strength modifier + Proficiency Bonus); on a failure it is teleported to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of you, or the nearest one, and its Speed becomes 0 until the end of that turn.

feature.name: Battering Roots
feature.summary: Your reach with Heavy or Versatile melee weapons grows by 10 feet, and their hits can add Push or Topple.

feature.name: Travel along the Tree
feature.summary: When you rage and as a Bonus Action while raging, teleport up to 60 feet; once per Rage, teleport 150 feet with willing companions.
